_comment: One environment's settings for the provider notices kit. Copy it once per environment (settings.test.json, settings.production.json), replace every <placeholder> in each enabled provider, and file each copy with the change record. Names and IDs only, never a secret: each provider's reader signs in through its own CLI or a managed identity, and the ServiceNow token is read from the environment variable named in routing.tokenVariable at run time. Read-PnSettings refuses a file with a secret-like value, or a placeholder left in an enabled provider. The commands are the same for test and production; only this file changes. Not run against a live tenant, account, tenancy or project.
